Bacterial vaginosis Bacterial vaginosis (anaerobic vaginosis; non-specific vaginitis) results from a reduction of the normal vaginal bacteria (Lactobacillus spp.) and an overgrowth of anaer- obic bacteria (including Gardnerella vaginalis, Mycoplas- ma hominis, or Mobiluncus or Prevotella spp.). It is a com- mon and often distressing condition that is not thought to be sexually transmitted but is generally associated with sexual activity.
